name: buffer__remote-mcp
description: Buffer's official remote MCP server for social media scheduling. Lists connected channels, reads, creates, edits and deletes scheduled posts and drafts, captures ideas, manages post templates, reads aggregated post analytics, and exposes raw GraphQL query and mutation tools. OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration; a Buffer API key also works as a bearer token. Available on every Buffer plan, including Free.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return the signed-in account and its organizations: email, name, timezone, current time, and each organization's ID, name, plan limits and member count.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List the social accounts connected to an organization with each channel's ID, name, display name, service, type, avatar and connection status.

tools.name: get_channel
tools.description: Return one channel's posting schedule, posting goals, queue status, timezone, link-shortening settings and service-specific data.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List an organization's posts with ID, status, text, scheduled and sent times, channel, tags, assets, source and any publishing error.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Read one post in full: status, content, author, channel, tags, notes, assets and allowed actions.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Schedule or publish a post on one channel (Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, Mastodon, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky or Start Page).

tools.name: edit_post
tools.description: Update an existing post; the whole record is validated.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Permanently delete a post.

tools.name: get_aggregated_post_metrics
tools.description: Sum analytics across many posts over a date range, returning totals and averages.

tools.name: list_ideas
tools.description: List the ideas saved in an organization for future posts.

tools.name: list_idea_groups
tools.description: List the columns on the ideas board with ID, name and lock status.

tools.name: create_idea
tools.description: Save a new idea without scheduling or publishing it.

tools.name: list_post_templates
tools.description: List an organization's reusable post templates.

tools.name: get_post_template
tools.description: Read one template's body, title, description, emoji, visibility and timestamps.

tools.name: create_post_template
tools.description: Create a post template with private or internal visibility.

tools.name: update_post_template
tools.description: Update only the specified fields of a post template.

tools.name: delete_post_template
tools.description: Permanently delete a post template.

tools.name: introspect_schema
tools.description: Return the complete GraphQL schema of the Buffer API.

tools.name: execute_query
tools.description: Run a read-only GraphQL query against the Buffer API.

tools.name: execute_mutation
tools.description: Run a GraphQL mutation against the Buffer API.
